411701.name: Salvo
411701.description: Fires a barrage of assault rifle shots, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

411702.name: Laser Cannon
411702.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

411703.name: Special Bullet: Stun
411703.description: Fires special bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.

411704.name: Piercing Shot
411704.description: Fires bullets that can pierce through cover, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

411705.name: Enhanced Spherical Bomb Barrage
411705.description: Fires a barrage of highly fortified bombs, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The bombs can be intercepted by hitting them repeatedly.
